pass_b_english: Show knowledge by works — as ministers commended 'in glory and dishonor, as deceivers and true; as unknown and well known; as dying, and behold we live.' (2 Corinthians 6:4–10) Let no stumbling-block be given, that the ministry be not blamed, but in all things commending: through honor won by confession and dishonor borne from torturers, through good report of angels and evil report of men — deceivers in persecutors' eyes, true before God.
